recipes.name: Sour Cream Mushroom Dip
ingredients_raw: 0.25 teaspoon garlic salt, or to taste
1 pinch ground black pepper, or to taste

steps.text: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Heat the butter in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in the mushrooms and onion; cook and stir until the mushrooms have softened and the onion is translucent, about 7 minutes. Stir in the spinach, parsley, garlic salt, and pepper. Continue cooking until the spinach has wilted, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in 1/2 cup of Cheddar cheese. Cool for 5 minutes. Stir in the sour cream, then spread mixture into an 8x8-inch baking dish. Sprinkle 1 cup of Cheddar cheese on top.
Bake in the preheated oven until the cheese has melted, about 20 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Sour Cream Mushroom Dip
raw_recipe.description: The earthy flavor of mushrooms brings this spinach and Cheddar cheese dip to life.

review.reviewBody: Simple and impressively good. Works great with pretzels, too!

I left out the butter and just sauted onion and mushrooms in sprayed skilled until most of the liquid evaporated then followed the rest of the directions using fat free sour cream and velveta shreds except left the extra cheese off the top. Served with tortilla chips. Creamy and mushroomy goodness.

I had my doubts when I was preparing this, but it was delicious! I doubled the recipe but only used 1/4 cup butter and drained the mushroom/onion/spinach mixture before adding cheese. I also used only 1 cup of sour cream (even tho I doubled all other ingredients) as it looked way soupy with just that amount. I also goofed and threw almost all of the last addition of cheese in and mixed it instead of putting it on top! But, I thing doing so got rid of the soupiness. Very tasty! Could taste the mushrooms even with all that cheese. Will make again!

Well, I liked this quite a bit. I didn't use any onion, and I used fresh garlic instead of garlic salt, and fresh parsley rather than dried. Cooked mushrooms until they had lost their juices and were starting to brown, then added about 3 cups of spinach along with the other ingredients. Used reduced-fat cheddar cheese and light sour cream. Processed the mixture briefly to get a more uniform chop. Held dip in the refrigerator about 4 hours before baking...husband waited to tell me AFTER I'd put it together that he's not all that fond of mushrooms (8 years married, and he can still surprise me!), but I liked it, and my company liked it. I'd make it again, but I think I'd use a different cheese...Gruyere or Swiss would probably be excellent. Thanks for a keeper!
This recipe is a party favorite. I substitute regular sour cream for “sour cream and chives” and add artichoke. The additions give the dip a nice flavor pop. Highly recommend!

I doubled the recipe, except for the sour cream, it only seemed to need one cup. After heating it in the oven the cheese on top turned rubbery. I just stirred it in and let it melt when I reheated it. I think it would be great without the cheese on top. So great on roast beef or toasted French bread rounds. It's even better a day or two later!

Made this as directed . Was very greasy , due to the amount of butter , and the cheese . The taste of the mushrooms , and spices were just o.k. , and think it would have been better if fresh were used , instead of dried . This was very mediocre for us , and would not make as directed again . Maybe with less butter , and fresh herbs and spices . Sorry for the bad review . Thanks for sharing .
This was quite good! I used low fat sour cream and way less butter and it was fine. I tried to be fancy with the cheese, but I think the asked for Cheddar would have been better.
Very good! I made it as a side dish and served it over rice. Wonderful flavor!
this was just as greasy as another cook posted. It needs a binder or something. Flavor wasn't too bad but presentations awful.

Loved this recipe. Very easy to make and true mushroom flavor. I doubled the recipe and took it for a Christmas Eve appetizer. Served with bagel chips, pita chips and onion crackers. Was a big hit, definitely will make again.
Big hit with all guests. I used quit a bit more spinach to make it thicker but it was delish!
Delicious! Eating it right now. I used dehydrated onions (like French Onion soup mix) and a little extra cheese. SO yummy. Will be making this again at Christmas.
So good!! I added garlic croutons and only had plain yogurt, but still came out great. Quick, easy and delicious!!!

I followed this recipe exactly and although it was pretty tasty, it was also really watery due to all the mushrooms. We actually ended up straining the water when storing the leftovers and it was much better today when heated up. It definitely wasn't my favorite dip though, so I will probably not make it again.
So easy and tasty!! This recipe is great just as it is.
I just recently made this for a large group of people so I doubled the recipe. It was a huge hit with everyone. We all really liked it. It was quite yummy! I will make this one again. Thank-you!
